brief: Jab, jab, cross: two left jabs that land on the target's head at 0.5 s and 0.85 s, the hand coming back to the guard between them, then a right cross on the chin at about 1.38 s; both feet stay planted.
notes: Fighter 2 is a still target facing the hero. 30 fps.

asserts.line: left fist touches fighter 2 head at 0.5 s +-2 f
left fist touches fighter 2 head at 0.85 s +-2 f
left fist at least 10 cm from fighter 2 head at 0.7 s +-1 f
right fist touches fighter 2 chin at 1.38 s +-3 f
